info.name: NYCTaxiData API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection auto-generated from source code for the NYCTaxiData ASP.NET Core Web API.

Architecture: Clean Architecture (CQRS + MediatR)
Auth: JWT Bearer (Issuer: NYCTaxiData, Audience: NYCTaxiData)
SignalR Hubs: /hubs/taxi, /hubs/tracking, /hubs/dispatch, /hubs/simulation

Roles:
- Manager  → AdminController endpoints
- Admin / Dispatcher → AnalyticsController endpoints
- Authenticated → most other endpoints

variable.description: Base URL for the API. Change to your deployed URL when needed.
JWT Bearer token. Obtained from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Set automatically by the Login request's test script.

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints: login, registration, OTP flow, token refresh, and profile retrieval.
Base route: /api/v1/auth

request.description:
Registers a new driver account.

Command: RegisterDriverCommand(FirstName, LastName, PhoneNumber, Password, Age, City, Street, LicenseNumber, PlateNumber)
Returns: Result<UserResultDto>

Registers a new manager account.

Command: RegisterManagerCommand(FirstName, LastName, PhoneNumber, Password, Age, City, Street, EmployeeId, Department)
Returns: Result<UserResultDto>

Sends a 6-digit OTP via WhatsApp/SMS to the specified phone number.
OTP expires in 5 minutes.

Command: SendOtpCommand(PhoneNumber)
Returns: ResultDto { isSuccess, message }

Resets the user's password using the resetToken obtained from /otp/verify.
Token expires after 15 minutes.

Command: ResetPasswordCommand(ResetToken, NewPassword)
Returns: UserResultDto

item.name: 🚗 Trips
item.description:
Trip management: CRUD, lifecycle (start/end), dispatch, online drivers, and detailed analytics.
Base route: /api/v1/trips
Auth: Bearer token required

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of trips with optional filters.

Query: GetAllTripsQuery(PageNumber, PageSize, StartDate, EndDate, DriverId, ProcessStatus)
Returns: Result<PaginatedList<TripDto>>

Returns a single trip by its integer ID.

Query: GetTripByIdQuery(TripId)
Returns: Result<TripDto>

Returns paginated trips that have a pickup or dropoff in a specific zone.

Query: GetTripsByZoneQuery(ZoneId, PageNumber, PageSize)
Returns: Result<PaginatedList<TripDto>>

Creates a new trip record.

Command: CreateTripCommand(DriverId, PickupLocationId, DropoffLocationId, FareAmount, TipAmount)
Returns: Result<TripDto>

Updates fare, tip, and status for an existing trip. The ID in the URL must match tripId in the body.

Command: UpdateTripCommand(TripId, FareAmount, TipAmount, ProcessStatus)
Returns: Result<TripDto>

Soft-deletes a trip by ID.

Command: DeleteTripCommand(TripId)
Returns: Result<bool>

Ends an active trip, computes the final fare based on duration.

Command: EndTripCommand(TripId, FarePerMinute=0.5, BaseFare=2.50, SurgeMultiplier=1.0)
Returns: Result<TripEndResultDto>

Manually dispatches a driver to a pickup/dropoff zone pair.

Command: ManualDispatchCommand(DriverId, PickupZoneId, DropoffZoneId, PassengerName, PassengerPhone, Priority, SmartRoutingEnabled, TripId?)
Priority values: NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT
Returns: Result<DispatchResultDto> { dispatchId, driverId, pickupZoneId, dropoffZoneId, status, dispatchedAt, passengerName, priority }

Updates a driver's availability status and current GPS coordinates (via TripsController).
Status values: Available, On_Trip, Offline

Command: UpdateDriverStatusCommand(DriverId, Status, CurrentLat, CurrentLng)

Returns a paginated list of currently available/online drivers.

Returns: PaginatedList<DriverListDto>

query.description: Optional Guid to filter by specific driver

request.description:
Returns paginated trip history, optionally filtered by driver.

Query: GetTripHistoryQuery(DriverId?, PageNumber, PageSize)
Returns: Result<PaginatedList<TripHistoryItemDto>>

Returns aggregate trip statistics: total, completed, ongoing, revenue, avg fare, avg tip, avg duration.

Query: GetTripsStatisticsQuery()
Returns: Result<TripStatisticsDto>

Returns revenue statistics for a date range.

Query: GetRevenueStatisticsQuery(StartDate?, EndDate?)
Returns: Result<RevenueStatisticsDto>

Returns demand statistics (trip counts, patterns) for a date range.

Query: GetDemandStatisticsQuery(StartDate?, EndDate?)
Returns: Result<DemandStatisticsDto>

Returns trip aggregates grouped by zone (pickups, dropoffs, revenue).

Query: GetZoneStatisticsQuery()
Returns: Result<List<ZoneStatisticsDto>>

Returns per-driver activity statistics (trips completed, revenue generated).

Query: GetDriverActivityQuery()
Returns: Result<List<DriverActivityDto>>
Development-only endpoint. Creates a minimal Trip entity and returns audit fields (CreatedBy, CreatedAt) to validate EF Core interceptors.

item.name: 👨‍✈️ Drivers
item.description:
Driver management: listing, fleet monitoring, profile, shift statistics, status updates, and offline data sync.
Base route: /api/v1/drivers

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of drivers with optional status and zone filters.

Query: GetDriverListQuery(Status?, ZoneId?, PageNumber, PageSize)
Returns: Result<PaginatedList<DriverDto>>

Returns a paginated list of active (non-offline) fleet drivers.
Response is cacheable.

Query: GetActiveFleetQuery(PageNumber, PageSize)
Returns: Result<PaginatedList<ActiveFleetDriverDto>>

Returns detailed profile and current statistics for a single driver.

Query: GetDriverProfileQuery(DriverId)
Returns: Result<DriverProfileDto>

Returns shift-level statistics for a driver within an optional time window.
Response is cacheable.

Query: GetShiftStatisticsQuery(DriverId, ShiftStartUtc?, ShiftEndUtc?)
Returns: Result<ShiftStatisticsDto>

Updates a driver's availability status and GPS coordinates.
Status values: Available | On_Trip | Offline

Body: UpdateDriverStatusRequest(Status, CurrentLat, CurrentLng)
Command: UpdateDriverStatusCommand(DriverId, Status, CurrentLat, CurrentLng)
Returns: Result<Unit>

item.name: 🗺️ Zones
item.description:
Zone analytics: listing, statistics, heatmap, comparisons, trends, history, driver distribution, and demand insights.
Base route: /api/v1/zones

request.description:
Returns aggregate trip statistics across all zones (no specific zone filter).

Query: GetZoneStatisticsQuery(null)
Returns: Result<...>

Returns a single zone by its ID.

Query: GetZoneByIdQuery(id)
Returns: Result<ZoneDto>

Returns trip statistics scoped to a single zone.

Query: GetZoneStatisticsQuery(id)
Returns: Result<ZoneStatisticsDto>

Returns actionable insights for a zone: top dropoff destinations, avg wait time, peak period, driver efficiency score.

Query: GetZoneInsightsQuery(id)
Returns: Result<ZoneInsightsDto>

Returns the top recommended zones for drivers based on demand/supply ratio and revenue.

Query: GetRecommendedZonesQuery(limit)
Returns: Result<List<RecommendedZoneDto>>

Returns driver distribution across all zones: active, available, and on-trip counts.

Query: GetDriverDistributionQuery()
Returns: Result<List<DriverDistributionDto>>

item.name: 📊 Analytics
item.description:
Dashboard analytics: KPIs, demand velocity chart, and system threshold configuration.
Base route: /api/v1/analytics
Auth: Role = Admin OR Dispatcher

request.description:
Returns dashboard KPIs: active drivers count, total daily revenue, average queue time.
Requires: Admin or Dispatcher role.

Query: GetTopLevelKpisQuery()
Returns: Result<TopLevelKpisDto> { activeDriversCount, totalDailyRevenue, averageQueueTimeMinutes }

Returns chart data for AI demand velocity predictions over a time window.
Requires: Admin or Dispatcher role.

Query: GetDemandVelocityChartQuery(Hours, ZoneId?)
Returns: Result<DemandVelocityChartDto>

Returns current system threshold settings: surge multipliers and dispatch radius thresholds.
Requires: Admin or Dispatcher role.

Query: GetSystemThresholdsQuery()
Returns: Result<SystemThresholdsDto> { surgeMultipliers: {normal, elevated, critical}, dispatchRadiusKm: {normal, elevated, critical}, lastUpdatedUtc }

Updates system-wide surge multiplier and dispatch radius threshold settings (stored in distributed cache, expires in 12h).
Requires: Admin or Dispatcher role.

Validation:
- surgeMultipliers.normal: 1.00 – 2.00
- surgeMultipliers.elevated: > normal, ≤ 3.00
- surgeMultipliers.critical: > elevated, ≤ 5.00
- dispatchRadiusKm.normal: > 0, ≤ 10
- dispatchRadiusKm.elevated: > normal, ≤ 20
- dispatchRadiusKm.critical: > elevated, ≤ 30

Command: UpdateSystemThresholdsCommand(SurgeMultipliers, DispatchRadiusKm)
Returns: Result<UpdateSystemThresholdsResultDto>

item.name: 🤖 AI / ML
item.description:
AI/ML prediction and optimization endpoints powered by an external Python ML service.
Base route: /api/v1/ai
ML Service Base URL (dev): http://127.0.0.1:8000/

request.description:
Predicts 15-minute demand for a list of zones.
ZoneId range: 1-265.

Command: PredictDemand15MinCommand(Zones: Demand15MinInput[], RoundToInt)
Returns: ApiResponse<List<Demand15MinResult>> { zoneId, p50, p90, lowerBound, upperBound }

Predicts ETA for a list of zone-to-zone routes.

Command: PredictETACommand(Routes: ETAInput[])
Returns: ApiResponse<BatchPredictionResponse<ETAResult>>

Optimizes vehicle repositioning across zones based on supply/demand state.
This is a transactional command — result may be persisted.

Command: OptimizeRepositioningCommand(TimeWindow, ZoneStates: ZoneSupplyState[], Constraints?)
Returns: ApiResponse<RepositioningPlan> { planId, createdAt, validUntil, totalMoves, vehiclesMoved, estimatedRelocationCost, estimatedRevenueGain, netProfitImpact, assignments[], zoneSummaries[] }

Optimizes driver distribution across zones to maximize profit in the next 6 hours.

Command: OptimizeProfitMaximizationCommand(ZoneStates: ProfitMaximizationInput[])
Returns: ApiResponse<ProfitMaximizationResult>

item.name: 🎮 Simulation
item.description:
Real-time faster-than-real-time taxi simulation engine.
Base route: /api/v1/simulation
SignalR push channel: /hubs/simulation

request.description:
Pauses a running simulation.

Returns: ApiResponse<SimulationStatusResponse>

Resumes a paused simulation.

Returns: ApiResponse<SimulationStatusResponse>

Stops and terminates the current simulation.

Returns: ApiResponse<SimulationStatusResponse>

Returns the current simulation status snapshot.

Returns: ApiResponse<SimulationStatusResponse> { simulationId, status, simulatedTime, currentHour, speedFactor, isPaused }

Returns a chunk of recorded simulation ticks for scrubbing/playback.

Returns: ApiResponse<SimulationPlaybackChunk> { simulationId, ticks[] }

Returns the list of zone IDs active in the current simulation.

Returns: ApiResponse<IReadOnlyList<int>>

Returns the recorded metric history for a specific zone during the simulation.

Returns: ApiResponse<ZoneHistoryResponse> { zoneId, points[]: { simulatedTime, demand, revenue, etaMinutes, stockoutRisk, driverCount, activeTrips } }

Returns simulation metric histories for two zones side-by-side for comparison.

Returns: ApiResponse<IReadOnlyList<ZoneHistoryResponse>>

item.name: 🛡️ Admin
item.description:
Administrative operations: manual data aggregation and dashboard statistics.
Base route: /api/v1/admin
Auth: Role = Manager (required)

variable.description: Date to aggregate (yyyy-MM-dd). Cannot be a future date.

query.description: Start date (ISO date). Default: 30 days ago.

request.description:
Returns daily aggregated stats from the DailyStats table for a date range.
Requires Manager role.
Max date range: 365 days.

Returns: { from, to, count, stats[] }

item.name: 📡 SignalR Hubs (WebSocket)
item.description:
Real-time WebSocket hubs using SignalR.
Authentication: Pass JWT via query string: ?access_token=<token>

Hub Endpoints:
- /hubs/taxi          → TaxiHub
- /hubs/tracking      → LiveTrackingHub  
- /hubs/dispatch      → DispatchHub
- /hubs/simulation    → SimulationHub

Note: These are WebSocket connection endpoints and cannot be tested directly via HTTP. Use a SignalR client or Postman's WebSocket feature.

query.description: JWT Bearer token passed via query string for SignalR WebSocket connections

request.description:
SignalR Hub for taxi real-time events.
URL: /hubs/taxi
Connect via SignalR client (not plain HTTP).
Auth: ?access_token={{authToken}}

SignalR Hub for live driver tracking.
URL: /hubs/tracking
Connect via SignalR client.

SignalR Hub for dispatch notifications.
URL: /hubs/dispatch
Connect via SignalR client.

SignalR Hub for simulation tick events.
URL: /hubs/simulation
Client receives SimulationTick events in real-time during active simulation.
Connect via SignalR client.
